messages:
Olivia: Quick follow-up from today's wins/losses: folks asked why we lose to VendorX on latency and pricing. Can we get a short summary and owners?
Ava (CEO): Top recurring asks: predictable committed pricing, reproducible latency SLOs (regional), and smoother Private onboarding + residency docs.
Ravi (Product): From CS interviews: customers want committed pricing examples, a migration ROI sheet, and a one-page Private runbook.
Priya (Customer Success): Also requests for 5-10min walkthrough videos showing Private deploy + audit logs.
Jordan (Eng): Note: a number of losses are single-digit-ms p95 mobile cases. We can meet them with narrow configs but need reproducible benchmark artifacts.
Maya (Sales): Procurement keeps asking for standard data residency & audit-log clauses. That blocks regulated buyers.
Ava (CEO): Proposed owners: Product -> pricing & onboarding packet; Eng -> SLO cookbook & bench runs; CS -> validation with lost accounts; Sales -> procurement templates. Small bench budget approved.
Ravi (Product): I'll draft a pricing one-pager and ROI table. ETA: next Wed.
Jordan (Eng): I'll produce an SLO cookbook (seq 32/128/512; GPU/CPU baselines) and run regional benches. ETA: 10 business days.
Priya (Customer Success): CS will test artifacts with 5 closed-lost accounts and record 2 walkthrough videos.
Maya (Sales): I'll prepare slide templates and draft contract language for Legal.
ops-bot: bench run queued, est. 10 GPU-hours across 2 regions; provisional cost ~$1k. Full quote in #eng-infra.
Claire (Strategy): I'll compile a short tracker with owners + ETAs and post in #all-hands-followup by EOD.
Olivia: Thanks all  please flag blockers here.
